info.title: TikTok Videos API: Profile Videos and Stats by Username, No Login
info.description:
Public TikTok videos by username or link as JSON, with captions, stats and transcripts.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/tiktok-videos (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: TikTok videos of any public profile or by video link, without login: caption, date, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, sound and the author's profile. Up to 20 videos per request, as JSON.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Usernames, @handles or profile links (https://www.tiktok.com/@nasa). Each profile's videos and photo posts are read from the newest back, up to the maximum below; every row carries the account's bio, bio link and exact follower count. Hashtags and search terms cannot be read here.

videoUrls.title: Video links
videoUrls.description: Links of single videos or photo posts (https://www.tiktok.com/@nasa/video/7692161454694206733), share links (vm.tiktok.com/…, tiktok.com/t/…) or bare video ids. Every link gives one row with the same columns as a profile's videos. Links of hashtag, search and music pages cannot be read here.

maxResults.title: Maximum videos per profile
maxResults.description: Videos to save for each profile, newest first. A request returns 20 rows at most.

postedAfter.title: Posted on or after
postedAfter.description: Only a profile's videos from this UTC day on (YYYY-MM-DD), or from a period back from now (7 days, 2 months). Not applied to video links.

postedBefore.title: Posted on or before
postedBefore.description: Upper end of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD) for a profile's videos. Not applied to video links.

includeTranscript.title: Add the spoken text
includeTranscript.description: Puts the text of TikTok's own subtitle track into the column transcript, for every video that has one. A video without a track (music, no speech, or not captioned by TikTok) keeps an empty column. This is TikTok's text, not speech recognition by the API.

commentsPerVideo.title: Comments per video
commentsPerVideo.description: Comments to save for each video, as rows of their own after the video rows: text, author, likes, reply count, time. 0 reads no comments. The number counts comments and replies together.

maxRepliesPerComment.title: Replies per comment
maxRepliesPerComment.description: Replies to read under each comment that has some; they follow their comment and count towards the comments per video. 0 keeps to top-level comments.

201.description: The results, one object per row.
